prompt: A repository is marked as a template. Which statements are true? Choose all that apply.
explanation: A template is a reusable mold: "Use this template" produces an independent repository with its own history that you can change freely. The template itself stays untouched and reusable.

options.text: Anyone with access can generate a new repository from it with one click
The generated repository starts with a fresh commit history
The generated repository is not a fork of the template
Generating from the template deletes the template repository
Files from the template cannot be changed in the new repository
